```{r}
  NA,
  nrow = n,
  ncol = n

rownames(erc_full) <- genes
colnames(erc_full) <- genes

  vals <- as.numeric(
    erc[i-1, 1:(i-1)]
  )
  
  erc_full[i, 1:(i-1)] <- vals
}

  t(erc_full)[upper.tri(erc_full)]
```

```{r}
#4.function
#erc_full <- readRDS('erc_dmel.RDS')
get_pairwise_erc <- function(mat, set1, set2 = NULL){
  if(is.null(set2)){
    sub <- mat[set1, set1]
    sub[upper.tri(sub, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
    vals <- as.numeric(sub)
  } else {
    sub <- mat[set1, set2]
    vals <- as.numeric(sub)
  }
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  return(vals)
}

#4.Define
background <- rownames(erc_full)
bg <- get_pairwise_erc(erc_full,background)
median(bg)
```

```{r}
## group vs background
erc_test <- function(mat, set1, set2 = NULL, background_genes = NULL, n_perm = 1000){
  if(is.null(set2)){
    obs_vals <- get_pairwise_erc(mat, set1)
  } else {
    obs_vals <- get_pairwise_erc(mat, set1, set2)
  }
  obs <- median(obs_vals)
  if(is.null(background_genes)){
    background_genes <- rownames(mat)
  }
  n1 <- length(set1)
  perm_stats <- numeric(n_perm)
  set.seed(123)
  for(i in 1:n_perm){
    rand_set <- sample(background_genes, n1)
    if(is.null(set2)){
      rand_vals <- get_pairwise_erc(mat, rand_set)
    } else {
      rand_vals <- get_pairwise_erc(mat, rand_set, set2)
    }
    perm_stats[i] <- median(rand_vals)
  }
  p_emp <- (sum(perm_stats >= obs) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  z <- (obs - mean(perm_stats)) / sd(perm_stats)
  return(list(
    obs = obs,
    perm = perm_stats,
    p_emp = p_emp,
    z = z,
    values = obs_vals
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# Cross group comparison
erc_group_group_test <- function(mat, set1, set2, background, n_perm = 1000){
  obs_vals <- get_pairwise_erc(mat, set1, set2)
  obs <- median(obs_vals)
  n1 <- length(set1)
  n2 <- length(set2)
  perm <- numeric(n_perm)
  set.seed(123) 
  for(i in 1:n_perm){
    r1 <- sample(background, n1)
    r2 <- sample(background, n2)
    perm[i] <- median(get_pairwise_erc(mat, r1, r2))
  }
  p <- (sum(perm >= obs) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  z <- (obs - mean(perm)) / sd(perm) 
  return(list(obs = obs, perm = perm, p = p, z = z, values = obs_vals))
}
```
